verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents bulk copying data out of tables and stages with file formats for exporting (COPY INTO). It also offers Apache Iceberg tables stored in customer-managed cloud storage that external engines can read through Horizon Catalog, so table data can live in an open format outside Snowflake's proprietary storage. The evidence is thin on the exit itself: no named export formats, no whole-account export path, and nothing on exporting non-table assets. missing for 10: explicit documentation of open export formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV unload), a complete account-wide export/offboarding mechanism, export of non-table assets (semantic views, code, apps), independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating off Snowflake.
